body_markdown:
Building on the legacy of its control-focused boot range, Under Armour has unveiled the all-new Magnetico Elite 6. Engineered for players who dictate the tempo rather than react to it, the latest iteration of the Magnetico delivers enhanced touch, improved comfort and total control from the first whistle to the last.


Combining an adaptive fit with responsive cushioning and refined touch technology, the boot is designed for footballers who seek to influence every phase of the game. At the heart of the Magnetico Elite 6 is Under Armour's innovative Liquid Clone upper, engineered to mould seamlessly to the contours of the foot for a customised fit and enhanced first touch.
